label: Сложность
prompt: Match the number of semantic subjects and visual density within one reference composition, not the number of cells in a sheet.

label: Композиция
prompt: Transfer hierarchy, relative scale, spacing and overlap inside each composition, adapting to the requested subjects. Keep every object fully inside the output cell.

label: Цвета
prompt: Transfer dominant colors and accent proportions to appropriate surfaces, preserving optical behavior.

label: Орнамент
prompt: Transfer decorative motifs, pattern placement and repeat scale onto appropriate surfaces of the new subjects. Adapt the motifs to the active palette; do not copy text or brands.

label: Детализация
prompt: Match the selection and scale of construction and surface details; do not add subjects.

label: Материалы
prompt: Transfer visible surface identities and their main/accent roles to the requested objects. Do not infer unseen materials or copy sample geometry.

label: Ракурс
prompt: Match camera elevation, viewing direction, projection and relative composition size within the cell. Keep every subject fully contained; never copy cropping.

label: Пластика формы
prompt: Transfer proportions, rounding and bevel character to new subjects, preserving their identity and selected construction detail.

label: Свет
prompt: Transfer light direction, softness and highlight character, within our stylized editorial 3D language; do not copy the background.

label: Приём
prompt: Transfer the visible creative treatment to the requested subjects, keeping unselected material, color, camera and layout settings authoritative.
